lessons.claim: **The criterion for a completed run is metrics.json, not result.txt.** bdbot.runid.prepare_outdir uses result.txt as the completion marker, while the actual pipeline (run.execute) **does not write result.txt** -- even a completed run has only l4.json, metrics.json, observables.npz, spec.json and traj_A.gsd. In this session, judging 'incomplete' by the presence of result.txt while cleaning up **deleted 6 completed runs**. When cleaning up incomplete runs, always judge by the existence of metrics.json. (The deleted runs were regenerable, but the run_id changed -- because a field had been added to spec.params in between.)
